title: A bill to amend the Dayton Aviation Heritage Preservation Act of 1992 to adjust the boundary of the Dayton Aviation Heritage National Historical Park, and for other purposes.
latestAction: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Energy and Natural Resources.
summary: This bill adjusts the boundary of the Dayton Aviation Heritage National Historical Park to include approximately one acre of land in Dayton, Ohio.

actions.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Energy and Natural Resources.
